text: Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: 18.0 to 18.8 s flooded street held. The brown water climbs on the white car from the lower wheels to above the wheel arches; by 18.4 s the wheels are mostly submerged. The car is small, about a quarter of frame width, in the upper-middle band. The lower half remains empty pale paving. Caption sits directly under the car, touching the waterline area.
